# GdayMeetings 0.3.5

Adds authenticated, resumable imports of existing local meetings from meeting-notes. Preserves recordings, transcripts, summaries, notes, tags, speaker information, and original meeting artifacts. Chat history is excluded.

Imports verify audio byte counts and SHA-256 checksums, support meetings without recordings, reject conflicting archives, and safely recognize retries. Existing transcript edits supply searchable text. Importing does not run transcription or delete local originals.

Includes SQLite and PostgreSQL migrations. Deploy this image and the updated meeting-notes daemon, sign in under Settings → Services, then use Copy existing meetings to Gday. Keep /app/data persisted and back up the database and audio before upgrading.

Container: ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.3.5. The release updates latest after native container smoke checks. The image index contains only linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
